content:
Rina Patel: FYI we're running an EBR for Helix next Wed 9:30am PT. Need final deck, one-pager, and a prioritized action table by Tue 5pm. I'm short on the renewal ask language  who can help tighten?

Tomas Alvarez: I can take the renewal ask. Proposing two options: (A) 6-month reserved capacity at x% discount, or (B) performance SLA + trial of Dedicated. Will draft crisp language and $$ impact.

Zoe Liu: I'll own onboarding + enablement slides. Will include cohort activation curves and playbook adoption rates. Sharing draft link: https://drive.redwood/helix/ebr-draft-v2

Marcus Ford: Demo lead here. Prefer live but prepping 90s video fallback and a sequence-of-screenshots deck. Will QA with a staging tenant Tue night.

ops-bot: Event created: "Helix EBR - Dry Run" Wed 08:00 PT. Auto-reminder 30m prior.

Rina Patel: Runbook excerpt below  please ack tasks and owners: 

```
Run order:
1) Rina - Executive context & topline (4m)
2) Zoe - Health metrics & onboarding (7m)
3) Tomas - Renewal ask + fiscal impact (5m)
4) Marcus - Demo (8m) / fallback explanation (2m)
5) Action capture & next steps (10m)

Action items:
- Zoe: finalize activation curves and annotation (Mon EOD)
- Tomas: draft renewal language + finance numbers (Tue noon)
- Marcus: upload fallback video + screenshots (Tue 9pm)
- Rina: assemble one-pager + exec TLDR (Tue 5pm)
```

Zoe Liu: Quick flag  activation metric uses new event naming; I'll include a note so execs don't trip on comparability.

Tomas Alvarez: Finance wants to see estimated monthly run-rate delta for option A. I'll loop in Maya from Finance and post numbers Tue morning.

Marcus Ford: Smoke test tonight shows a minor auth race on the staging tenant. If infra can't clear it, we'll push the recorded video. Tagging @infra-alerts.

Rina Patel: Good catch. Also, for the risk table, can we switch to numeric risk score (1-10) + top driver? Execs asked for that last quarter and it helped.

Zoe Liu: Agreed, will add numeric scores and call out three mitigation tickets with owners.

ops-bot: Runbook updated: /runbooks/helix-1950000000.md

Rina Patel: Thanks team  please mark done as you complete items. Plan on a full dry run Wed 8am PT and a leadership slice right after if all green. :thumbsup:
